Visited on 03 Oct 2026 with family while travelling on the highway.

The restaurant had a standee promoting a special dish – "Samaras Special 'A' Dawat (Kabab platter)" – but no price was mentioned on the standee or in the menu. We ordered it assuming a normal price and were charged Rs. 800, which we came to know only when the bill arrived after eating.

This is not about the money. Many travellers and families stop here, and promoting an item without showing its price is not fair to customers – once you have eaten, you cannot refuse to pay. Every item, especially specials on standees or boards, should have its price clearly displayed.

Tip for others: ask the price of any "special" dish before ordering.

Hope the management takes this feedback positively and displays prices clearly.

reviews.text:
Good food and a pleasing ambience can draw customers in but poor service can undo all of it. That is precisely what disappointed my family and me during our visit to Samara's Veg.
Let's start with the positives. The restaurant has ample parking space and a spacious dining area. The interior has lots of tables and a charming fountain too. I was quite pleased with the restrooms for being well-maintained and clean.
However, while this seemed nice, once we ordered our food, that's when the quality of the place came down a lot. We ordered a plain dosa, poori and a butter masala dosa. When I recieved my plain dosa, I was discontented to find it cold. The waitress then informed me that I had been served the wrong order and we asked to take the dosa back. This was frustrating, particularly because my family’s orders had arrived and they had already begun eating. My family's orders came in time and they started eating but I had to wait for 30 minutes before I finally got my order. Although the dosa itself met my expectations, the 30-minute wait and the mishandling of my order had already soured the dining experience.
This experience left me wondering how crucial good service is to a restaurant's well-being. The food can taste amazing, the atmosphere can look engaging and the location can be perfect. But if the service is poor, the entire experience will not be worth it.
I would kindly request the management team to improve their service quality and ensure that orders are given to the right table. I would also ask them to assure the food is hot and fresh rather than cold.
I hope the management takes this feedback seriously so that future diners can enjoy the experience this restaurant's ambience and food promise.

owner_response.text: Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We sincerely apologize for the incorrect order, the delay, and the inconvenience caused to you and your family. This is certainly not the standard of service we aim to provide. We’re glad you appreciated our ambience and facilities, but we understand that timely service and serving fresh, hot food are equally important to a pleasant dining experience. We will share your concerns with our team and work on improving our order accuracy and service efficiency. We truly value your feedback and hope to have another opportunity to provide you and your family with the experience you deserve.

reviews.text: A truly disappointing experience from start to finish. The service was unorganized, staff were inattentive, and getting someone to take our order or respond to our requests was unnecessarily difficult. Even after placing the order, we faced further delays, and the food did not meet our expectations. A restaurant should value its customers’ time and provide basic hospitality, but unfortunately, that was missing here. The management needs to address these service issues urgently and ensure better staff coordination and food quality. Definitely not an experience worth repeating.

Your feedback is important to us, and we will share your concerns with our management team to help us improve.
